title: Scp-049 The Plague Doctor
style: dark photorealistic found-footage horror photograph, desaturated, heavy 35mm film grain, crushed blacks, one harsh light source, unsettling, vertical composition, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no overlays

credit.author: Jade
credit.line: Based on SCP-049 by Jade - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-049 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: He thinks you're sick, and his cure is one touch. Would you let him close enough?

Hero.look: short dark hair, black Foundation jacket with high collar, shoulders slightly hunched

scenes.image_prompt: Wide dark empty stone cellar, large black empty space at top, far away a tall figure in a beaked ceramic mask and dark robes, black doctor's bag, barely visible, one dim lamp, crushed blacks, heavy grain, desaturated, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: A man in a plague doctor's mask was found calmly taking notes while corpses attacked the police. The mask grew out of its body.

scenes.label: WHAT IT DOES
scenes.image_prompt: Close detail of a pale lifeless hand lying on a cold concrete floor beside a scattered black leather glove, single flashlight beam, nobody in frame, crushed blacks, heavy grain, desaturated, photorealistic, {style}

lines.text: It believes people are sick with the Pestilence, and one touch of its skin stops a body completely.

scenes.label: WHY IT'S DANGEROUS
scenes.image_prompt: Grainy black-and-white security camera frame from a high corner, dim old house room, tiny still figure in a beaked mask and dark robes far away, slumped bodies on the floor, heavy grain, {style}

lines.text: Then it operates on the dead, and they rise empty and obedient. Police found several in Montauban.

scenes.label: HOW IT'S CONTAINED
scenes.image_prompt: Empty sealed containment cell, steel door, lone chair facing the wall, one wrong detail: a black doctor's bag left open on the floor, single cold emergency light, crushed blacks, heavy grain, desaturated, {style}

lines.text: So a secret group that hides the impossible keeps it sedated in a sealed cell at Site-19, collared whenever it moves.

scenes.label: WHO WATCHES IT
scenes.image_prompt: Flashlight beam through haze down a concrete corridor, far end a tall figure in a beaked ceramic mask and dark robes half swallowed by darkness, restraint harness chains on the floor, heavy grain, desaturated, {style}

lines.text: Two armed guards go along, and if it turns aggressive, they use lavender to calm it.

scenes.label: THE MISTAKE
scenes.image_prompt: Grainy black-and-white security camera frame from a high corner, long corridor, tiny motionless figure in a beaked mask and dark robes at the far end, a lone guard's flashlight on the floor, heavy grain, {style}

lines.text: Tonight that guard is you, and when it says you carry the Pestilence, you cough, just once.

scenes.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder, out-of-focus back of {Hero}, dark hair, black Foundation jacket, in foreground; in a dark doorway a tall beaked ceramic mask and dark robes at the edge of a flashlight beam, heavy grain, {style}

lines.text: The room goes quiet. Your radio is silent, and something warm rests on your neck.

scenes.image_prompt: Grainy security camera frame, tall figure in a beaked ceramic mask and dark robes very close behind a hunched guard, lit only by one red emergency light, partly out of focus, mostly darkness, heavy grain, {style}

lines.text: Do not move, friend. My hand is already on your neck. Hold still, and let me cure you.
